name: Memories.ai
tagline: A 'visual memory' layer for AI — search and reason over huge video libraries.
description: Video understanding platform built around a large visual memory model. It ingests long-form and large-scale video, then supports natural-language search, transcription, clip retrieval, and content analysis with unlimited video context. Applied to security and surveillance review, sports analytics, media production, and robotics, with a free playground and on-device processing options.
insight: Founded in 2024 by ex-Meta engineers who built the AI behind the Ray-Ban smart glasses.

modelSupport.notes: Runs its own large visual memory model for video.

edge: Built for unlimited-length video context — indexes and reasons over large video libraries that general multimodal models truncate.
pros: Handles very long and large video sets
